_comment: Round 2: one bank, one tenant (nexabank). No super_admin / app_admin / license scoping. A persona is a RENDER LENS over the same verified numbers (CLAUDE.md §7) — it never widens what is readable. The only KPI-level entitlement is: the ops_manager persona does not see revenue, and cannot back-compute it (`ops_hides`). selectable is the server-side allowlist; a ?persona= / X-User-Persona request is honoured only if it is in it.
